description: Compact BO render space using zero-floor continuous parameters instead of separate visibility booleans.

mask_alpha.meaning: 0 hides the target mask; higher values increase target mask opacity.

contour_thickness_px.meaning: 0 hides the contour; higher values increase target boundary thickness.

trajectory_alpha.meaning: 0 hides the trajectory ribbon; higher values increase trajectory visibility.

label_scale.meaning: 0 hides labels; values above roughly 0.6 show readable labels.

background_dim_alpha.meaning: 0 means no dimming; higher values dim irrelevant background context.

palette_id.meaning: Selects one predefined colour palette. Raw RGB is not optimised.
